basic.name: Shadow Waltz
basic.description:
After 0.5 seconds, deal 165~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in a line. 

Hitting a Hero with Shadow Waltz sets its cooldown to 2 seconds, refunds 35 Mana, and causes Orphea to dash a short distance upon moving.

basic.name: Chomp
basic.description: After 0.625 seconds, deal 305~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies in front of Orphea.

basic.name: Dread
basic.description: Release a wave of dread that deals 85~~0.04~~ damage to enemies hit. Dread erupts 0.75 seconds after reaching the end of its path, dealing 175~~0.04~~ damage. Enemies hit by Dread's wave or eruption are Slowed by 25% for 2 seconds.

heroic.name: Crushing Jaws
heroic.description: After 1.25 seconds, pull enemies in an area towards the center, dealing 250~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

heroic.name: Eternal Feast
heroic.description: After 1.5 seconds, deal 210~~0.04~~ damage in an area. Eternal Feast repeats every 1 second as long as it hits an enemy Hero.

trait.name: Overflowing Chaos
trait.description:
Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability grants 1 Chaos. Chaos can stack up to 3 times.

While Orphea has Chaos, her Basic Attacks against Heroes consume all Chaos, dealing 50% increased damage per stack, and healing for 100% of the damage dealt.

trait.name: Overflowing Chaos
trait.description:
Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability grants 1 Chaos. Chaos can stack up to 3 times.

While Orphea has Chaos, her Basic Attacks against Heroes consumes all Chaos, dealing 50% increased damage per stack, and healing for 100% of the damage dealt.

activable.name: Lurking Terror
activable.description: After Dread erupts and for 2 seconds after, activate to cast Chomp from the eruption area. Enemy Heroes hit by this Chomp are Slowed by 70% for 1.5 seconds.

activable.name: Final Toccata
activable.description: Activate to instantly reset the cooldown of Shadow Waltz. For the next 5 seconds, dashing with Shadow Waltz resets its cooldown and increases the duration of Final Toccata by 1 second.

level1.name: En Pointe
level1.description: Shadow Waltz deals an increased 90% damage to enemies hit by its end and grants 1 additional Chaos.

level1.name: Growing Nightmare
level1.description:
Increase Dread's damage by 50%. 

Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single cast of Dread's eruption.

Reward: Permanently increase Dread's eruption damage by 50% and increase the Slow amount of Dread's eruption by 15%.

level1.name: Ancestral Strength
level1.description: Non-Heroic Abilities deal 15% more damage to Stunned, Rooted, Silenced or Slowed enemies. Enemy Heroes who are hit with Overflowing Chaos are Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

level4.name: Allegrissimo
level4.description:
Reduce the cooldown of Shadow Waltz by 1 second.

Hitting Heroes with the end of Shadow Waltz sets its cooldown to 0.75 seconds.

level4.name: Backbiter
level4.description:
If Chomp hits a Hero, Orphea immediately dashes a short distance backwards.

Passive: Gain 15% maximum Health.

level4.name: Chaotic Assault
level4.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes while having 3 stacks of Chaos deal an additional 75% bonus damage.

level7.name: Insatiable
level7.description: Hitting a Hero with Chomp sets its cooldown to 2 seconds.

level7.name: Ravenous Hunger
level7.description:
Quest: Minions that die within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Chomp permanently increase its damage by 2 and heal Orphea for 60~~0.04~~. 

Heroes that die increase its damage by 40 and heal Orphea for 25% of her maximum Health.

level7.name: Mind Devourer
level7.description:
Quest: Hitting Heroes with Dread increases its damage by 5, up to 150.

Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, hitting an enemy Hero with Dread's eruption sets its cooldown to 6 seconds and refunds 50 Mana.

level10.name: Eternal Feast
level10.description: After 1.5 seconds, deal 210~~0.04~~ damage in an area. Eternal Feast repeats every 1 second as long as it hits an enemy Hero.

level10.name: Crushing Jaws
level10.description: After 1.25 seconds, pull enemies in an area towards the center, dealing 250~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

level13.name: Determination
level13.description: After dashing with Shadow Waltz, Orphea gains 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability, stacking up to 2 times. While Orphea has Determination, her Physical damage is increased by 15%.

level13.name: Abyssal Symbiosis
level13.description: Hitting a Hero with Chomp instantly grants Orphea maximum Chaos and a 170~~0.04~~ Shield for 3 seconds.

level13.name: Invasive Miasma
level13.description: Activate to deal 150~~0.04~~ damage to all nearby enemies after 2 seconds. For each Hero hit, heal for 182~~0.04~~ and gain 1 Chaos.

level16.name: Bond of Anguish
level16.description: Shadow Waltz deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 3% of their maximum Health, healing Orphea for 50% of damage dealt.

level16.name: Dead Magic
level16.description: Basic Attacks that consume Chaos ignore Armor and deal 90~~0.04~~ Spell Damage to the target and all enemies around them.

level16.name: Lurking Terror
level16.description: After Dread erupts and for 2 seconds after, activate to cast Chomp from the eruption area. Enemy Heroes hit by this Chomp are Slowed by 70% for 1.5 seconds.

level20.name: Monster Within
level20.description: Eternal Feast grants 1 Chaos each time it hits a Hero. While Eternal Feast is active and for 5 seconds afterwards, Orphea's Basic Abilities recharge 150% faster.

level20.name: Engulfing Oblivion
level20.description: Crushing Jaws reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 50 for 3 seconds. Takedowns set its cooldown to 5 seconds.

level20.name: Eldritch Conduit
level20.description: Each Chaos consumed increases Orphea's Spell Power by 3%, up to 30%. After reaching the maximum bonus, the Spell Power is increased by an additional 30%. Lasts 10 seconds.

level20.name: Final Toccata
level20.description: Activate to instantly reset the cooldown of Shadow Waltz. For the next 5 seconds, dashing with Shadow Waltz resets its cooldown and increases the duration of Final Toccata by 1 second.
